description: A photograph depicts a large white passenger airplane, possibly an Airbus A320 family aircraft, parked on a wet asphalt tarmac at an airport. The view is captured from inside an airport terminal or jet bridge, looking out through a window framed by vertical and horizontal bars. The aircraft features blue detailing on its engine nacelles and nose cone. The tarmac is reflective due to moisture from rain, mirroring the overcast grey sky. In the background, other airplanes, airport buildings, and various pieces of ground support equipment are visible, illustrating the complex infrastructure of an active airport environment. This image serves as a visual example for the "Airports and associated land" land cover class.
